name: sub2api-custom-deployer
description: Reapply and verify the Sub2API armor group, Codex quota overdraft, and bounded 429 upstream reconnect customizations after upstream updates.

interface.shortDescription: Restore three Sub2API custom features after an update.
interface.longDescription: Applies and adapts three ordered Sub2API customizations: the Codex quota overdraft fork, the armor group (group-level Codex instructions), and bounded fresh-connection retries for selected upstream 429 responses. It preflights patches in a temporary Git worktree, preserves existing work, and verifies backend and frontend integration markers.
defaultPrompt: 更新 Sub2API 后恢复破甲分组、额度透支和 429 重连
检查当前 Sub2API 是否完整安装三个自定义功能
把三个功能适配到新的 Sub2API 上游版本
